subject: general
question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct options:
Assertion (A): The murals in Tirumalaipuram and Sittanavasal caves are important surviving examples of Pandya art.
Reason (R): These murals are mainly found on the outer walls of temples and depict mythological war scenes.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
Both A and R are false

solution:
The correct answer is __**3) A is true, but R is false**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

 
 
• **Assertion (A):** The murals in **Tirumalaipuram** and **Sittanavasal caves** are important surviving examples of **Pandya art**. This statement is **true**. 
 
 
• The Sittanavasal cave paintings, located in Tamil Nadu, are one of the finest examples of early Pandya art and culture. 
 
• These paintings primarily depict scenes of daily life, animals, and lotus ponds, showcasing the artistic skills of the Pandya period (7th century CE).
 
• The murals in these caves were created using the **fresco-secco technique**, which involves painting on dry plaster.
 
• Similarly, the Tirumalaipuram caves also hold significant artistic value, with inscriptions and carvings attributed to the Pandya dynasty.
